parameters.name: input_dir
parameters.description: Directory containing the input data files.
parameters.help_text: Directory containing the input data files.

parameters.name: output_dir
parameters.description: Directory where output files will be saved.
parameters.help_text: Directory where output files will be saved.

parameters.name: tmp_dir
parameters.description: Directory for temporary files created during processing.
parameters.help_text: Directory for temporary files created during processing.

parameters.name: frame_rate
parameters.description: Frame rate [Hz] fallback used only when it cannot be read from acquisition/session/platform metadata.
parameters.help_text: Frame rate [Hz] fallback used only when it cannot be read from acquisition/session/platform metadata.

parameters.name: diameter
parameters.description: Expected diameter of cells in pixels. If set to 0, CellPose will estimate the diameter from the data.
parameters.help_text: Expected diameter of cells in pixels. If set to 0, CellPose will estimate the diameter from the data.

parameters.name: init
parameters.description: Initialization method for finding masks. Options: max/mean: Cellpose on max projection image divided by mean image; mean: Cellpose on mean image; enhanced_mean: Cellpose on enhanced mean image; max: Cellpose on maximum projection image; sourcery: Suite2p's functional mode without 'sparse_mode'; sparsery: Suite2p's functional mode with 'sparse_mode'; greedy_roi: CaImAn's functional 'greedy_roi' mode; corr_pnr: CaImAn's functional 'corr_pnr' mode.
parameters.help_text: Initialization method for finding masks. Options: max/mean: Cellpose on max projection image divided by mean image; mean: Cellpose on mean image; enhanced_mean: Cellpose on enhanced mean image; max: Cellpose on maximum projection image; sourcery: Suite2p's functional mode without 'sparse_mode'; sparsery: Suite2p's functional mode with 'sparse_mode'; greedy_roi: CaImAn's functional 'greedy_roi' mode; corr_pnr: CaImAn's functional 'corr_pnr' mode.

parameters.name: functional_chan
parameters.description: this channel is used to extract functional ROIs (1-based)
parameters.help_text: this channel is used to extract functional ROIs (1-based)

parameters.name: threshold_scaling
parameters.description: adjust the automatically determined threshold by this scalar multiplier
parameters.help_text: adjust the automatically determined threshold by this scalar multiplier

parameters.name: max_overlap
parameters.description: cells with more overlap than this get removed during triage, before refinement
parameters.help_text: cells with more overlap than this get removed during triage, before refinement

parameters.name: soma_crop
parameters.description: crop dendrites for cell classification stats like compactness
parameters.help_text: crop dendrites for cell classification stats like compactness

parameters.name: allow_overlap
parameters.description: pixels that are overlapping are thrown out (False) or added to both ROIs (True)
parameters.help_text: pixels that are overlapping are thrown out (False) or added to both ROIs (True)

parameters.name: denoise
parameters.description: If True, applies denoising to the binned movie before cell detection.
parameters.help_text: If True, applies denoising to the binned movie before cell detection.

parameters.name: cellprob_threshold
parameters.description: Probability threshold for CellPose cell detection. Decrease this threshold if CellPose is not returning enough ROIs.
parameters.help_text: Probability threshold for CellPose cell detection. Decrease this threshold if CellPose is not returning enough ROIs.

parameters.name: flow_threshold
parameters.description: Flow threshold used by CellPose during cell detection. Increase this threshold if CellPose is not returning enough ROIs.
parameters.help_text: Flow threshold used by CellPose during cell detection. Increase this threshold if CellPose is not returning enough ROIs.

parameters.name: spatial_hp_cp
parameters.description: Window size for spatial high-pass filtering of the image before CellPose detection. Set to 0 to disable filtering.
parameters.help_text: Window size for spatial high-pass filtering of the image before CellPose detection. Set to 0 to disable filtering.

parameters.name: pretrained_model
parameters.description: CellPose pretrained model to use. Common options: 'cyto' (standard model), 'cyto2' (improved model), or path to a custom model file.
parameters.help_text: CellPose pretrained model to use. Common options: 'cyto' (standard model), 'cyto2' (improved model), or path to a custom model file.

parameters.name: neuropil
parameters.description: Method to estimate and subtract neuropil contamination, and whether to perform demixing. cnmf(-e) demix traces of overlapping ROIs via NMF, suite2p & mutualinfo do not. Options: 'cnmf' (CaImAn standard: low-rank background of CNMF), 'cnmf-e' (CaImAn for endoscopic data: ring model of CNMF-E ), 'suite2p' (fixed r=0.7), 'mutualinfo' (optimize r by minimizing mutual information).
parameters.help_text: Method to estimate and subtract neuropil contamination, and whether to perform demixing. cnmf(-e) demix traces of overlapping ROIs via NMF, suite2p & mutualinfo do not. Options: 'cnmf' (CaImAn standard: low-rank background of CNMF), 'cnmf-e' (CaImAn for endoscopic data: ring model of CNMF-E ), 'suite2p' (fixed r=0.7), 'mutualinfo' (optimize r by minimizing mutual information).

parameters.name: k_components
parameters.description: Maximum number of components to be found per patch when using greedy_roi or corr_pnr initialization in CaImAn (CaImAn's 'K'). Named with more than one character so pydantic-settings renders a long CLI flag: a single-character field becomes a short option (-k), which a Code Ocean app panel cannot emit.
parameters.help_text: Maximum number of components to be found per patch when using greedy_roi or corr_pnr initialization in CaImAn (CaImAn's 'K'). Named with more than one character so pydantic-settings renders a long CLI flag: a single-character field becomes a short option (-k), which a Code Ocean app panel cannot emit.

parameters.name: nb
parameters.description: Number of background components if using CaImAn with neuropil=cnmf.
parameters.help_text: Number of background components if using CaImAn with neuropil=cnmf.

parameters.name: rf
parameters.description: Half-size of patches in pixels for CaImAn processing. If 0, the entire FOV is processed as a single patch. Larger patches are more memory-intensive.
parameters.help_text: Half-size of patches in pixels for CaImAn processing. If 0, the entire FOV is processed as a single patch. Larger patches are more memory-intensive.

parameters.name: stride
parameters.description: Overlap between neighboring patches in pixels for CaImAn processing. Should be smaller than rf.
parameters.help_text: Overlap between neighboring patches in pixels for CaImAn processing. Should be smaller than rf.

parameters.name: tsub
parameters.description: Temporal downsampling factor during initialization phase in CaImAn. Higher values speed up processing but may miss transients.
parameters.help_text: Temporal downsampling factor during initialization phase in CaImAn. Higher values speed up processing but may miss transients.

parameters.name: ssub
parameters.description: Spatial downsampling factor during initialization phase in CaImAn. Higher values speed up processing but may miss smaller cells.
parameters.help_text: Spatial downsampling factor during initialization phase in CaImAn. Higher values speed up processing but may miss smaller cells.

parameters.name: ssub_B
parameters.description: Additional spatial downsampling factor for background during CNMF-E processing.
parameters.help_text: Additional spatial downsampling factor for background during CNMF-E processing.

parameters.name: merge_thr
parameters.description: Trace correlation threshold for merging components in CaImAn. Components with correlation above this value will be merged.
parameters.help_text: Trace correlation threshold for merging components in CaImAn. Components with correlation above this value will be merged.

parameters.name: min_corr
parameters.description: Minimum local correlation for a component to be considered in corr_pnr initialization. Higher values result in fewer, more reliable components.
parameters.help_text: Minimum local correlation for a component to be considered in corr_pnr initialization. Higher values result in fewer, more reliable components.

parameters.name: min_pnr
parameters.description: Minimum peak-to-noise ratio for a component to be considered in corr_pnr initialization. Higher values result in fewer, more reliable components.
parameters.help_text: Minimum peak-to-noise ratio for a component to be considered in corr_pnr initialization. Higher values result in fewer, more reliable components.

parameters.name: snr_thr
parameters.description: Signal-to-noise ratio threshold for component acceptance in CaImAn evaluation. Components below this value will be rejected.
parameters.help_text: Signal-to-noise ratio threshold for component acceptance in CaImAn evaluation. Components below this value will be rejected.

parameters.name: rval_thr
parameters.description: Spatial correlation threshold for component acceptance in CaImAn evaluation. Components below this value will be rejected.
parameters.help_text: Spatial correlation threshold for component acceptance in CaImAn evaluation. Components below this value will be rejected.

parameters.name: cnn_thr
parameters.description: CNN classifier threshold for component acceptance in CaImAn evaluation. Components below this value will be rejected. Set to 0 to disable CNN-based classification.
parameters.help_text: CNN classifier threshold for component acceptance in CaImAn evaluation. Components below this value will be rejected. Set to 0 to disable CNN-based classification.

parameters.name: contour_video
parameters.description: If True, creates a video overlaying raw data, ROI activity, and residual with contours for visualization and quality assessment.
parameters.help_text: If True, creates a video overlaying raw data, ROI activity, and residual with contours for visualization and quality assessment.

parameters.name: verbose
parameters.description: Enable verbose logging and debug information.
parameters.help_text: Enable verbose logging and debug information.

parameters.name: verify
parameters.description: Round-trip the emitted processing.json / quality_control.json through the core v2 schema objects after writing, so bad output fails in-capsule rather than downstream.
parameters.help_text: Round-trip the emitted processing.json / quality_control.json through the core v2 schema objects after writing, so bad output fails in-capsule rather than downstream.

parameters.name: suite2p_params
parameters.description: Serialized JSON string of Suite2p parameters to override defaults. Only applied when running a Suite2p-based init mode (max/mean, mean, enhanced_mean, max, sourcery, sparsery). Pipeline-controlled keys (input/output paths, fs, nbinned, do_registration, roidetect, spikedetect, neuropil_extract, bin_duration, and any key already exposed as a CLI flag) are stripped before merging; dropped keys are logged. Applied AFTER --suite2p-ops, so it wins on key collisions.
parameters.help_text: Serialized JSON string of Suite2p parameters to override defaults. Only applied when running a Suite2p-based init mode (max/mean, mean, enhanced_mean, max, sourcery, sparsery). Pipeline-controlled keys (input/output paths, fs, nbinned, do_registration, roidetect, spikedetect, neuropil_extract, bin_duration, and any key already exposed as a CLI flag) are stripped before merging; dropped keys are logged. Applied AFTER --suite2p-ops, so it wins on key collisions.

parameters.name: suite2p_ops
parameters.description: Path to a Suite2p ops.npy file to load parameters from. Only applied when running a Suite2p-based init mode. Pipeline-controlled keys (same set stripped from --suite2p-params) are filtered before merging; dropped keys are logged. Merged BEFORE --suite2p-params so JSON overrides win.
parameters.help_text: Path to a Suite2p ops.npy file to load parameters from. Only applied when running a Suite2p-based init mode. Pipeline-controlled keys (same set stripped from --suite2p-params) are filtered before merging; dropped keys are logged. Merged BEFORE --suite2p-params so JSON overrides win.
